dogecoin.text: These people thought they could buy off a spirit of God. That's insane. Even after May 2021 when Elon Musk was standing in the federal reserve manipulating the price of Dogecoin, I rejected your billions and you still thought I wanted money? My business here on earth is done
I am sticking with dogecoin . Loyalty is my weakness.
